item.title: Junior Business Developer OOH at Oatly
item.description:
Copenhagen's bravest oat enthusiast with commercial drive

If you walk past a new café and think, “I wonder who owns that place,” keep reading.

At Oatly, we’re looking for a Business Developer to join our Danish team in Copenhagen. Someone who likes people, new places, and the feeling of opening a door that was closed yesterday.

You’ll spend a big part of your time out on the streets. Not on Teams. Not in PowerPoint. Out where the coffees are made, menus are decided, and great relationships begin. Your mission is pretty simple to explain: Get more of the right cafés, restaurants, and bakeries to choose Oatly.

How you do that is a little less simple.

We know exactly which places we’d like to work with. Your job is to figure out who makes the decisions, walk through the door, start the conversation, listen, and, most importantly, follow up. Find the right reason to come back and show why Oatly can be so much more than just another carton behind the bar.

Some say yes. Some say no. Some say no three times, and yes the fourth. We want a person who will get a yes, no matter how many tries are needed.

You don’t need to follow the traditional route into sales. Maybe you come from the café, restaurant, or coffee world. Maybe you’ve already worked in a commercial role. What matters most is that you have the drive, curiosity, and courage to create your own opportunities.

You need to enjoy reaching out to people, including the ones you haven’t met yet. You need to be able to work independently without becoming a lone wolf. And you should be curious about both the customer’s business and the world they operate in.

We’re a small Danish team that works closely together, shares ideas, helps each other out, debates taste, customers, and things that probably shouldn’t be up for discussion.

We’re looking for someone who wants to get out there and find the next place before everyone else discovers it.

Sounds a little too much like you?

Cool. Then we’d love to hear from you.

Hello potential future Oatly employee

It's us. The original oat drink company. At Oatly, we're on a mission to make it easier for people to eat better and live healthier lives without recklessly taxing the planet's resources. Simple as that.

Across the world people’s consumption habits and diets are evolving to be more plant-based. Enter Oatly, the #1 oat based dairy alternative producer in the world with products spanning multiple categories.

We’re determined on being part of the discussion on the long-term future of the food and beverage industry. To keep this movement going, we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the Oatly flowing.

Sustainability, nutritional health and trust are at the heart of what we do. We are building a culture that constantly upgrades each other so we can upgrade the planet. This is a company that shows great respect and a fearless approach to make positive change. Does this feel exciting? Well, this is where you come in.

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO

The purpose of this role is to expand Oatly’s presence in the Out of Home (OOH) market in Denmark. You will identify new business opportunities, build strong relationships, and create awareness for plant-based alternatives in the food and beverage scene.

Here are the main elements of the role...

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities in the Copenhagen OOH landscape.

  • Conduct frequent field visits to stay close to market developments and customer needs.

  • Build and maintain a strong network within the Horeca and coffee scene.

  • Map your network in Oatly’s CRM system and manage prospecting activities.

  • Support Oatly events and brand activations to maximize impact.

  • Meet and exceed sales targets while promoting Oatly’s values.

In this role, you will report into the Commercial Director OOH, and the location for this role is Copenhagen, Denmark.

This next section is for all the bullet point lovers out there...

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE

Ready to make your mark in the food & beverage world?
We’re on the lookout for passionate, driven individuals who love building relationships and thrive in fast-paced environments. If you’re excited about shaping the Out-of-Home experience and growing with a dynamic team, this is your opportunity!

What you’ll bring to the table:

  • 3-5 years of experience in a commercial role, ideally in Out-of-Home, field sales, or FMCG.

  • A strong connection to Horeca or the food & beverage scene, you know the vibe and feel at home there.

  • A valid driver’s license.

  • Fluency in Danish & English.

Extra points if you have:

  • A track record in lead generation, prospecting, and hitting measurable targets.

  • Confidence with CRM tools, Microsoft Office, and social media know-how.

  • Experience in entrepreneurial environments or scale-ups.

  • A network and/or strong connection to the city of Copenhagen.

Join us and be part of a team that values ambition, creativity, and growth. If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear your story!

WHO WE NEED YOU TO BE

We think your oatsomeness is built upon the following qualities:

  • Result-oriented and proactive, you go out, get things done, and achieve your targets.

  • A natural hunter who identifies opportunities and acts fast.

  • A team player who thrives in collaboration.

  • Socially skilled and persuasive, able to connect with people at all levels.

  • A relationship builder who creates trust and long-term partnerships.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by change.

And beyond that:

  • You are a passionate advocate for sustainability who strives to create societal shifts and drive the plant-based revolution.

  • You have a charismatic presence and a knack for steering conversations while diplomatically focusing the room on what matters.

  • You are an entrepreneur at heart, with the know-how to create forward momentum and the stamina to relentlessly drive the process.

To be the perfect fit for Oatly, we believe you have a thirst for knowledge and are a result-driven person with high integrity. You thrive with a hands-on approach, even in times of rapid change. Your social competence allows you to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.

Finally, we hope that you share our values and have a great interest to carry out our mission in order to make the world a little bit better. 

Another bulleted list felt redundant, so we made this page talking about all the benefits we offer to sweeten the deal of working with us before you apply – if you're curious, check out this fancy page right here!

YOUR APPLICATION

Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make.

As you can probably tell, we’re a norm-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, let’s do this together! It will be fun!

Last day of application: 10th November.

We treat all candidates equally: If you are interested, please apply through our application system - any correspondence should come from there. This will ensure that the candidate experience is smooth and fair to everyone!

Love Oatly 💚

 #LI-TA1

item.title: Community Manager UK
item.description:
Due to demand, we'll be closing applications for this role Sunday 8th November.

Hello potential future Oatly employee. It’s us, the original oat drink company that started in Sweden back 30 or so years ago.

We exist to make it easy for people to eat better and live healthier lives without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process. Sustainability, health, and transparency are the core values that guide everything we do. We're also recognised as the world’s first Climate Solutions food and beverage company, and we do it all while making some of the most delicious drinks out there.

If any of this is resonating with you, then maybe you’d like to come work with us? If so, you're in the right place.

The Role

We’re looking for a Community Manager to be one of the voices of Oatly across our social channels and emails, bringing our tone of voice to life while treating our consumers like the heroes they are. You’ll help grow and protect Oatly’s community by supporting consumers, building meaningful relationships and bringing what we learn from our communities back into the business.

Here are the main elements of the role:

  • Build meaningful relationships with our community through thoughtful, accurate, timely, and on-brand interactions across social media, email and other digital platforms, while managing consumer questions and complaints with care.

  • Proactively grow and deepen Oatly’s community. Do this by engaging with relevant people, communities, internet culture, trends and brand moments, while staying curious about what our communities are saying and spotting emerging themes, opportunities and risks.

  • Bring strong UK market knowledge into our global Community team. Build relationships with local Brand and Comms partners, collaborate on campaigns, activations and Community projects, and turn global Community strategy into locally relevant action.

Who You Are

If the below sounds like you, you could be a good match for this job:

  • You have at least one year’s experience in community management, social media, consumer engagement, customer service or another relevant communications or community-facing role.

  • You’re a strong and engaging writer, able to adapt your tone for different people, platforms and situations.

  • You’re comfortable giving and receiving feedback to make writing sharper and clearer, while finding your own accent within Oatly’s tone of voice.

  • You’re organised and comfortable managing competing priorities while keeping sight of the bigger picture.

  • You’re proactive and solutions-focused, using good judgement, taking initiative and bringing thoughtful recommendations when challenges arise.

  • You’re collaborative and enjoy working closely with teammates and partners across different functions and markets.

  • You have experience spotting trends and proactively engaging in internet culture, community conversations or relevant brand moments.

  • You are able and willing to come to our brand new offices in Farringdon 2 to 3 days a week.

  • Experience using social media management tools would be a bonus.

  • And if you’re bilingual, that'd be a big plus!

The Perks

Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make. As you can probably tell, we’re a norm-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. Good luck!

A Note On AI
We don't mind if you use AI to help you prepare to interview with us. You could use it to spell check, do some research, or even practice for an interview – it's up to you. But please don't copy and paste answers from AI, or give examples that don't reflect your experience. Read more here.

item.title: Underhållstekniker Oatly Landskrona
item.description:
Hej, potentiella framtida Oatly-medarbetare

Det är vi, havredrycksföretaget! På Oatly har vi ett tydligt uppdrag: att göra det enklare för människor att äta bättre och leva hälsosammare, utan att tära på planetens resurser. Enkelt, men viktigt. Runt om i världen väljer allt fler människor växtbaserade alternativ, och vi är stolta över att vara en del av den förändringen. Som världens ledande havredrycksföretag utvecklar vi produkter inom flera kategorier och arbetar varje dag för att inspirera fler att välja havre.

Samtidigt vill vi vara med och driva den större omställningen av livsmedelssystemet. För att fortsätta utmana, utveckla och skapa förändring behöver vi fler nyfikna, modiga och engagerade människor som vill vara med på resan. Kanske är du en av dem?

VAD DU KOMMER ATT GÖRA

Som Underhållstekniker i vår fabrik i Landskrona blir du en del av ett erfaret team som arbetar med underhåll, felsökning, reparation och förbättringar av utrustningen. Rollen är varierande och innebär både planerat och avhjälpande underhåll, installationer och felsökning i hela anläggningen. Du får en strukturerad introduktion på dagtid innan du går över till skiftarbete.

Underhållsorganisationen består av 8 skiftgående tekniker, 4 dagtidstekniker, en koordinator och en chef. Vi söker nu en skiftgående tekniker för att möta vår växande produktion.

Fabriken körs dygnet runt med en modern maskinpark. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt med att förbättra och utveckla mer proaktivt underhåll för att säkerställa maskintillgänglighet, funktion och kvalitet till lägsta livstidskostnad inom ramarna för hälsa, miljö och säkerhet. Du arbetar självständigt under eget ansvar i nära samarbete med övriga kollegor både i och utom teamet. Du tillhör underhållsteamet och rapporterar direkt till Underhållschefen.

Här är de viktigaste delarna av arbetet...

  • Dagligt arbete med att säkerställa driften på installerad maskinpark, Fu-ronderingar, rotorsaksanalyser, felsökningar och reparationer

  • Delta i utveckling av förebyggande underhåll med målsättningen att minimera driftstopp och optimera produktionskvaliteten

  • Delta vid ombyggnation och driftsättning av nya produktionslinjer

  • Utföra systematisk felsökning, underhåll och installation

  • Utbilda produktionspersonalen i felsökningar och enklare åtgärder

  • Hantera och utveckla underhållssystemet

  • Medverka vid framtagande av underhållsplaner

Vi ser gärna att du kan checka av följande:

Vi tror att du har arbetat i en liknande roll och har erfarenhet av att utföra och arbeta med planerat och förebyggande underhåll, felsökning och installation.

  • Du har utbildning på minst gymnasienivå med teknisk inriktning, med fördel el & automation, styr- & reglerteknik eller fordonsmekanik.

  • Du har erfarenhet från processindustrin, livsmedelsindustrin, mekanisk industri eller motsvarande.

  • Har du dessutom elbehörighet och erfarenhet av enklare PLC-programmering så är du extra intressant!

Du talar och skriver på svenska samt förstår engelska, och innehar körkort. Truckkort och/eller liftkort är meriterande.

DET HÄR TAR DU MED DIG

Vi växer och utvecklas hela tiden. För att trivas hos oss behöver du vara positiv till förändringar och tycka om att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du är ödmjuk och tar dig gärna an nya idéer och metoder. Att ha kontakt med både interna och externa parter är något som du får energi ifrån och du har lätt för att samarbeta.

Du uppskattar förändring och motiveras till en verksamhet i utveckling där du kan bidra med din erfarenhet och dina idéer för att sätta struktur och rutiner för drift- och underhållsarbetet.

VEM DU ÄR

Vi tror att du är en person som gillar att samarbeta, ta ansvar och göra ett bra jobb.

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du:

  • Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten

  • Är lösningsorienterad

  • Tar initiativ när det behövs

  • Är flexibel och öppen för förändringar

  • Bidrar till en positiv stämning på jobbet

  • Vill lära dig nya saker och utvecklas

Framför allt tror vi att du vill vara med och göra skillnad och bidra till en mer hållbar framtid.

ANSÖKAN

Sista ansökningsdag: 15 november.

Vi behandlar alla kandidater lika. Om du är intresserad, ansök gärna via vårt rekryteringssystem. All kommunikation sker därifrån för att säkerställa en smidig och rättvis kandidatupplevelse för alla.

Oatly XOXO

#LI-TA1

item.title: French student looking for a sales focussed internship in Belgium?
item.description:
Hello potential future Oatly employee. It’s us, the original oat drink company that started in Sweden back 30 or so years ago.

We’ve emerged as a leading and trailblazing player in the dairy-alternative market. As we continue to solidify our presence, we're committed to shaping the future of the food and beverage industry. With our rapid growth, we're on the lookout for more brilliant minds to come work with us to maintain our momentum and keep the oat drink flowing.

Our mission is to make it easy for people to eat better and live healthier lives without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources. If this resonates with you, then maybe you’d like work for Oatly, too. So, let’s get to the formal stuff.

The Assignment 

Are you a French student looking for a Sales focussed internship in Belgium? Keep on reading... Belgium is a relatively small country, and so is our Belgian team, but we are expanding quickly by making big waves in your neighbourhood supermarket, cafe around the corner and favorite restaurants. We are offering a 6 month internship role that supports the Retail & Out Of Home sales team to keep them hyper focused on selling our oat drinks. Ideally your internship starts in January 2027 and ends in July 2027.

You will be supporting the sales team on analyzing customer and market data and managing the administration related to commercial activities at retailers and wholesalers. What does that exactly mean you ask? Here’s the main elements of the role...

  • Ensuring correct execution and preparation of promotion plans

  • Analysis of sales performance and facilitating the introduction of new products

  • Determining sales opportunities in the foodservice landscape

  • Assisting in sales activations and tastings

  • Support with ad-hoc queries in our office in Brussels or for our team on the road

Who You Are

If the below sounds like you, we'd love to see an application:

  • You dream about oats, Oatly, people, and the planet, and can't wait to turn those dreams into reality with us.

  • You are a French student looking for a Sales focussed internship in Belgium. 

  • For the duration of the internship you are willing to relocate to Brussels.

  • You are a star in organizing things.

  • You are system savvy, (Microsoft Office, etc...)

  • You are fluent in French and English.

  • We're a growing team in Belgium, so not everything will run smoothly as we figure new things out – so you're comfortable diving into mild levels of disorder and (even better if you can put improvements in place).

Another bulleted list felt redundant, so we wrote this long sentence with all the ways we sweeten the deal to work with us: opportunity to join our brand and build your sales skills, an internship allowance of 900 euro per month, expense allowance for business trips, paid days off, tools to maintain mental and psychical wellbeing and last but not least an amazing group of high energy enthusiastic colleagues.

[Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make.

As you can probably tell, we’re a norm-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. Good luck!]
